title: jSnow17: a differentiable JAX implementation of the Snow-17 snow model
description:
Dual-backend (JAX + NumPy) implementation of the Snow-17 temperature-index snow accumulation and ablation model, with functional and BMI interfaces.

Part of the SYMFLUENCE JAX-native model family, described in the paper series accompanying SYMFLUENCE (Eythorsson et al., 2026, Water Resources Research).
